errors.text_span: Категориите са подредени в произволен ред.
errors.evidence: The description makes an unsubstantiated claim that the categories on the x-axis are arranged in an arbitrary order. This is an interpretation of the author's choice, not a description of the visual representation.

The y-axis label is missing, so stating that the values represent a percentage ratio is an interpretation, not a direct description from the chart. The reference description correctly notes that the unit is not specified.
The description states the y-axis has intervals of 10, but the labeled tick marks on the chart are at intervals of 20 (0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120).
The description uses the label 'Въглища (TEL)' but the legend in the figure clearly shows 'Въглища (ТЕЦ)'.

errors.text_span: като в някои случаи определени сегменти са визуално подчертани чрез различни цветове
errors.evidence: This phrase is confusing and misrepresents how the chart uses color. The different colors are used to encode different energy source categories according to the legend, not to 'visually highlight' certain segments.
